name: Explicit Surface to TSDF Conversion
definition: A method to convert explicit geometry (meshes or point clouds) into TSDF values by computing closest-surface distances and assigning signs based on normals or offset fallbacks.
summary: Explicit Surface to TSDF Conversion transforms triangle meshes or point clouds into voxel grids by computing closest-surface distances, differing from projective methods by operating directly on geometric primitives rather than depth images.
